signature: "IOHANN IOSEPH SCHMIED 1783 VOR DIE SCHWERTAISCHE KIRCHE."
provenance: Originally from the same set as 17832; ex Paul de Wit, Leipzig.¹
remarks: 2 tubular slide stays, lower one not telescoping; ring pattern on ferrules and slide stays; long strip of brass (perhaps a repair) at slide bow; ring at slide bow; flat bell stay with zigzag pattern around entire circumference; garland has simple circular form, no scallops, with concentric rings, 3 above and 2 below signature; festoon pattern on garland; ring and saddle in bell bow; brass patch in neck pipe and between stay and pre-bow ferrule. Examined by sac August 2002.
